nodes.label: Moderatori/Admin Persona
nodes.rationale: Every listing is reviewed by real people before publication; moderators work in dense, operational surfaces.

nodes.label: adottaungatto.it Marketplace Purpose
nodes.rationale: Italian marketplace for responsible cat adoption: geolocated and breed search, human-moderated listings, direct contact between adopter and lister without intermediaries. Success metric is a conscious adoption; the site must remain an operational marketplace, not a decorative landing page.

nodes.label: Brand Personality (warm, reliable, curated)
nodes.rationale: Clean professional marketplace (Airbnb/Idealista base) that is unmistakably 'cats': logo palette (coral, amber, teal, olive) as measured accents, real cat photography as the primary emotional material, human microcopy. Emotion yes, childishness no.

nodes.label: Design Principles (photos carry emotion, search-first, visible trust)
nodes.rationale: 1) Real cat photos are the emotional protagonist, UI is a clean frame; 2) clean where you work (filters/account/moderation), warm where you choose (home/detail); 3) trust states always readable with logo color semantics (teal=trust, olive=positive outcome); 4) brand is the logo palette used with restraint, never dominant fills or small raw-color text; 5) the first screen orients to search, not narration.

nodes.label: Anti-References (design directions to avoid)
nodes.rationale: Avoid: editorial-pastel/magazine look (cream + serif italic) already judged 'not professional' by the owner; pet-kitsch (paw prints, cartoon cats, confetti); generic SaaS landing (gradients/orbs, uppercase eyebrows, hero metrics, default glassmorphism); cold corporate pure-zinc with no brand warmth.

nodes.label: WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility Standard
nodes.rationale: Contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text including accessible variants of logo colors (coral-strong/teal-strong for text and CTAs), visible focus, prefers-reduced-motion respected on every animation, touch targets >= 44px on mobile.
